name: Fieldset
summary: A fieldset is a set of controls under one question, named by its legend. Use it when the controls only mean something together: several answers to the same question, or the parts of one answer. The legend has to be the first child, and "pick at least one" is a rule HTML cannot express.
demoNote: Uncheck everything under Payment methods and the group reports it — a rule `required` cannot express. The last example locks a group twice over: `disabled` cascades and takes the keyboard with it, `aria-disabled` cascades to nothing and keeps the reason reachable.

contract.useWhen: Related controls under one question, named by a legend.
keyboard: native: one stop per control — a fieldset is not one stop
native: toggles a checkbox inside it
native: move and select inside a radio group, nothing for checkboxes
states: disabled — aria-disabled=true on the fieldset, which stays focusable so it can say why
failureModes: role=group on a fieldset, replacing working semantics with hand-written ones
aria-label on the fieldset instead of a legend, so the group is named for AT and untitled on screen
the legend not the first child, where it stops being the name
the error on the fieldset's own description, which is read inconsistently — put the id on every control
a legend as a flex item, which older Safari refuses: wrap the body in a div
api: AC.createFieldsetGroup(root, options) -> { validate, count, inputs, element, destroy }
